spans.s:
doṣaḥ दोषः
Dosha
The regulatory functional factors of the body formed by the synchronized interplay between the five basic elements within any living system.

ITA-4.8.19 doṣagatiḥ दोषगतिः
Movement of dosha
When it is not physiological, the movement of dosha within the body is a pathogenic mechanism which results in the manifestation of disease in different tracts.

ITA-9.6.223 doṣaghnalepaḥ दोषघ्नलेपः
External application of dosha-alleviating paste
A type of ointment or lepa which alleviates doṣa.

ITA-2.8.2 doṣaprakṛti दोषप्रकृति
Body constitution with a predominance of dosha
Body constitution with a predominance of dosha (doshaprakriti) is a result of the baseline state of the doshas of sperm (shukra) and ovum (shonita) at the time of conception. Doshaprakriti is unique to each individual. It is immutable and does not change during a lifespan.

doṣabalapravṛttarogaḥ दोषबलप्रवृत्तरोगः
Disorders resulting from dosha imbalance
Diseases that manifest in the living system due to vitiation of body humours such as fever and bleeding disorders.

doṣahetuḥ दोषहेतुः
Vitiated dosha as a cause of disease
Seasonal variations leading to natural accumulation and aggravation of the dosha.

doṣahetuḥ दोषहेतुः
Causes which aggravate dosha
Causes which aggravate dosha irrespective of the disease.

ITA-9.1.52 doṣāvasecanam दोषावसेचनम्
Procedure to eliminate morbid dosha from body
Also a synonym of cleansing therapy.

ITA-9.1.62 doṣopakramaḥ दोषोपक्रमः
Dosha-specific therapeutic measure
A therapeutic measure or set of therapies with characteristics or properties which are antagonistic to specific dosha.
